newsitem.title: USA: MAY SAYS COMPLETED 6.4 MLN SHARE BUYBACK.
newsitem.headline: MAY SAYS COMPLETED 6.4 MLN SHARE BUYBACK.

text.p: May Department Stores Co said Monday that it completed during May 1997 the repurchase of $300 million in stock, totaling 6.4 million shares of May common stock at an average price of $47 per share.
This was in addition to a $600-million repurchase program, totaling 12.7 million shares at an average price of $47 per share, completed in the second half of 1996.
The company said the May 1996 and May 1997 share repurchase programs account for the difference between earnings per share growth and growth in net earnings.
The related incremental 1997 aftertax interest costs were $9 million and $16 million in the second quarter and six months, respectively, the company said in an earnings statement.

May earlier Monday reported second-quarter fully-diluted earnings of $0.46 per share vs $0.41 in the year-ago period. It reported net earnings of $116,000,000 versus $110,000,000 and net retail sales of $2,667,000,000 compared to $2,419,000,000 in the same year-ago period.
